hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Ball seat
function: The tapered seat at the top of the mandrel that the dropped ball lands on to close the plug.

tabs.overview: Seat diameter sets the ball size; flow-through when the ball is absent lets the well flow back through the plug before drillout in some designs.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
